'''Anthony''' is an [[NPC]] researcher found inside the Cassette Burning room.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}} 
:'''Zhuming:''' Did you see the incident report? That disciplinary action is harsh. You don't see that very often these days…
:'''Anthony:''' If you ask me, it's not harsh enough. You don't know what they did!
:'''Anthony:''' Those two selfish fools snuck off on their own to collect samples just to gain a smidge of progress in their project. The researcher who went to rescue them got completely consumed by the Voidmatter...
:'''Anthony:''' How is it fair that a good man is gone, and the ones responsible are still alive and kicking?
:'''Zhuming:''' Don't worry. The Institute has zero tolerance for breaking safety protocols. They will pay for their stupidity.
:'''Zhuming:''' They aren't worth your time. Not even your anger. Come on, focus on your research and look forward to the future.
:'''Zhuming:''' Maybe one day… we can use Cassettes to bring back those lost to the Voidmatter. It sounds like a pipe dream now, but turning dreams into reality is what science is all about, isn't it?
----
;After {{Quest|Starlights from Yesterdays}}
:; '''Zhuming''' So get this. I heard those two are petitioning to restart their project and get their disciplinary action softened.
:; '''Anthony:''' Over my dead body! [[Void Storm]] or not, selfish pricks like that are a walking liability!
: A researcher seems to be seething over what happened with two troublesome students.
:{{DIcon|Option}} (Listen)
:: '''Anthony:''' I don't think I'll ever forgive those two selfish bastards. After all...
:: '''Anthony:''' ...If the Void Storms are truly gone for good, doesn't that mean the people we lost in them are gone forever too?
:: '''Zhuming:''' I don't think their sacrifice was meaningless.
:: '''Anthony:''' I know! They were the pride of the [[Spacetrek Collective]]. I'm not GRIEVING their deaths... I'm FURIOUS. That's what I am.
:: '''Anthony:''' Every time I think about the colleagues we lost trying to save those two rule-breaking idiots, it makes my blood boil.
:: '''Zhuming:''' But... Anthony, did you know?
:: '''Zhuming:''' The two kids they saved back then? They joined the rescue team when [[Aleph-1]] hit.
:: '''Zhuming:''' When the Void Storm was expanding, they saved another search unit. And that unit brought back data on one of the Royan rune sites.
:: '''Zhuming:''' And those Royan runes... they're proof that the colleagues we lost in the Void Storm once existed.
:: '''Zhuming:''' Beyond the [[Stridergate]], they became torches, lighting the coordinates in [[Voidspace]] for the [[Exostrider]].
:: '''Anthony:''' Are you saying those two idiots helped fight Aleph-1 too?
:: '''Zhuming:''' No... I'm saying that driving back Aleph-1 was a miracle. Only that miracle was made possible by every single person within that closed loop of cause and effect.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} (Leave)
----
;Nearby
:;...How many times do I have to say this? In the frostlands, it's every man and woman for themselves. No one is going to hold your hand.
:;Running off like that cost us an exceptional colleague their life trying to rescue you… He even made sure to leave a final report before he disappeared.
:;Disciplinary actions will be reported along with details of the incident. After that, you'll be sent home to face trial under your local laws. That's the punishment you deserve.
:;And if you have any conscience left, remember this<nowiki>:</nowiki> a colleague gave their life to save you two fools.
{{Dialogue End}}
